notes: Every upcoming drop now carries a time of day: the manual sheet opens on today with a Drop time field you set, an upcoming row reads "drops Oct 3 at 7:23 AM" beside its countdown, and a drop whose catalog knows only the day reads "at time TBA" rather than leaving the hour a mystery.

Upcoming releases now looks the date up itself: every pinned artist is checked against MusicBrainz’s open catalog of announced releases, where a drop someone has already dated sits with its day set weeks before it lands — no account, no sign-in, no window.

The empty tab and the Home bubble no longer offer a Connect Spotify button: they now say "Check for drops" and run the same check on the spot, beside the "Add a drop manually" sheet — nothing in Upcoming releases asks you to connect anything anymore.

The release check now has a clock on every artist and always repaints the panel you are looking at, so the count, the rows and the empty state update the moment results land instead of sitting on old numbers.
Home no longer shows the pinned-artist check card: the check runs in the background while you browse, and any new drops still reach you through the bell badge and the New releases tab.
The manual drop sheet asks for the release title with no example in the way and opens on today’s date, so a drop is added with its time set and counted as soon as it is real.
